title: Easy to use, works great.
text: Easy to use, works great.. This toasts my bread evenly.  It's easy to use and easy to clean.  I haven't had it long, but I like it.  It's not a space hog on the counter.  I like that it fits bagels and english muffins, too.

product_metadata.title: Hamilton Beach Toaster, Sure-Toast Technology, Shade Selector, Bagel Setting, Brushed Stainless Steel (22220), 2 Slice Extra-Wide Slot
features: EVENLY TOASTS BOTH SIDES OF SINGLE SLICE: With the Sure-Toast One Slice toast feature on the 2 slice toaster, you get perfectly toasted bread, with balanced color and texture on both sides every time you toast. Just press the One Slice button.
FROM AMERICA'S #1 TOASTER BRAND*: Consumers love our toasters. We are the best-selling toaster brand in the U.S.
TOAST THICKER BREADS: The Hamilton Beach 2 Slice Toaster has 2 extra-wide slots to easily toast thicker breads like bagels and Texas toast.

EASILY RETRIEVE SMALLER BREADS: A convenient feature you won't find on all bread toasters, Toast Boost lets you lift smaller breads like English muffins and gluten-free bread slices so they're easier to retrieve after toasting.
KEEP COUNTERTOPS CLEANER: Conveniently remove and discard crumbs from the toaster. The slide-out crumb tray catches crumbs, so they don't end up on your countertop.
description: The Hamilton Beach® 2 Slice Brushed Stainless Steel Toaster evenly toasts both sides of bread, even when toasting one slice. Features include extra-wide slots for thicker breads, Toast Boost to lift smaller breads, a bagel function and Cancel button.
